articles.title: A fresh wave of cyberattacks has hit Europe’s supermarket refrigerators, destroying food across countries
articles.description: This is the second wave of cyberattacks to hit supermarket refrigerators in a month, spoiling food and disrupting supplies.
articles.summary: Europe's supermarket refrigerators have been targeted by a second wave of cyberattacks within a month, causing spoiled food and supply disruptions.
points: A second wave of cyberattacks has hit Europe's supermarket refrigerators within a month.
The attacks are spoiling food and disrupting supplies.
These attacks have been reported as one of the most significant threats to food security.
articles.insight: These recurring cyberattacks on food storage systems highlight the need for stronger cybersecurity measures within the food supply chain industry to prevent significant disruptions and losses.
